description: Least-privilege capabilities for the skill recorder's always-on-top controller strip. Deliberately grants no window close/hide/destroy: while a recording runs there must always be a surface that can stop it, and 'collapsible, not dismissible' is enforced here rather than by UI discipline. The command allow-list (recorder-controller-app-commands.toml) likewise excludes record_start and the whole bundle-read surface.
